site.anchor: as causas do art. 258

source.quote: Art. 258 - Se do crime doloso de perigo comum resulta lesão corporal de natureza grave, a pena privativa de liberdade é aumentada de metade; se resulta morte, é aplicada em dobro.

citations.cite: CP art. 258, rubric "Formas qualificadas de crime de perigo comum"

readings.description: Three arms are fractions ("aumentada de metade", "em dobro"): causes of increase applied in art. 68's third phase to the crime's own preceito; the fourth replaces the preceito (homicídio culposo's) and adds a third.
Each arm is a qualified form with new limits of its own (e.g. 6 to 12 years for arson with a death), read as the preceito.
readings.foreclosure: The text states fractions, not limits; the outer limits come out the same either way (`os limites da pena ... com as causas`).

taken.rationale: `a pena cominada ao …` gives the crime's own preceito (or the homicide's) and `as causas de aumento do …` the fraction; `os limites da pena … com as causas` gives what the other reading calls the preceito.

notes: Divergence 'none' for the outer limits; a caller that reads only `a pena cominada ao …` sees the base preceito, and must read the causes too.

readings.description: Possessing, holding, manufacturing or using an explosive or incendiary artefact falls under the Estatuto do Desarmamento; art. 253 remains for gases, supply, acquisition, transport and material for manufacture.

taken.rationale: The sweep's suggested reading, narrowed to the statute's word "artefato": "substância ou engenho explosivo" became two members, `substância explosiva` and `engenho explosivo`, and only possessing or making an `engenho explosivo` is taken (the Estatuto names no explosive substance). `o fato passou à Lei nº 10.826, de 2003, art. 16, § 1º, III` holds when, on or after 23.12.2003, every art. 253 verb in the fact is possuir or fabricar and every object an engenho explosivo; then the crime and penalty refuse by name.
